title: Add Airtable-like Filter Builder Component with Advanced Field Types
body:
## Implementation: Airtable-like Filter Component ✅

Successfully implemented an Airtable-like filter builder component for Object UI with full schema-driven configuration and interactive features.

### ✅ Completed Tasks

- [x] Create base UI component for filter builder (`packages/components/src/ui/filter-builder.tsx`)
- [x] Create filter rule component for individual filter conditions
- [x] Create renderer component that integrates with Object UI schema system
- [x] Add component metadata for designer integration
- [x] Add exports to package index
- [x] Build and test the component
- [x] Create example/demo usage
- [x] Test the component in playground
- [x] Address code review feedback
- [x] Add comprehensive documentation
- [x] Add date field support with native date picker
- [x] Add select field support with dropdown options
- [x] Add "Clear all" button functionality
- [x] Enhanced input types with proper type conversion
- [x] Simplify UUID generation

### 📸 Screenshots

#### Enhanced Filter Builder with Advanced Features
![Enhanced Filter Builder](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51a41d9f-05e2-49a5-a5ec-8c50572f9977)

The screenshot shows:
- **Clear all button** in the top right of each filter group
- **Date input field** for the "Join Date" filter with native date picker
- **Select dropdown** for the "Status" field with predefined options (Active, Inactive, Pending)
- **Number input** for numeric fields (Price field shows spinbutton)
- **AND logic toggle** between multiple conditions

#### Original Filter Builder Demo
![Filter Builder Demo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ea21417d-459f-49d5-bdb2-455d05b7719c)

#### Interactive Features (Dropdown Open)
![Filter Builder with Dropdown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63d1d636-e41f-45a4-b4bb-8c5d6ad96d10)

### ✨ Features Implemented

✅ **Dynamic Filter Conditions** - Add and remove filter conditions dynamically  
✅ **Field Selection** - Select from available fields with dropdown  
✅ **Type-Aware Operators** - Operators change based on field type (text, number, boolean, date, select)  
✅ **Value Input** - Smart input fields that adapt to field type:
  - Text fields: regular text input
  - Number fields: number input with spinbuttons (values stored as numbers)
  - Date fields: native date picker with proper ISO format
  - Select fields: dropdown with options
  - Boolean fields: true/false dropdown  
✅ **AND/OR Logic Toggle** - Switch between AND and OR logic when multiple conditions exist  
✅ **Clear All Button** - Quick way to remove all filters at once  
✅ **Schema-Driven** - Fully configurable via JSON schema  
✅ **Tailwind Styled** - Consistent with Object UI design system  
✅ **Shadcn Components** - Built with Radix UI primitives  

### 📦 Component API

#### Schema Definition

**Basic Usage:**
```typescript
{
  type: 'filter-builder',
  name: 'filters',
  label: 'Filters',
  fields: [
    { value: 'name', label: 'Name', type: 'text' },
    { value: 'age', label: 'Age', type: 'number' },
    { value: 'active', label: 'Active', type: 'boolean' }
  ]
}
```

**With Select Fields:**
```typescript
{
  type: 'filter-builder',
  name: 'filters',
  fields: [
    { 
      value: 'status', 
      label: 'Status', 
      type: 'select',
      options: [
        { value: 'active', label: 'Active' },
        { value: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

**With Date Fields:**
```typescript
{
  type: 'filter-builder',
  name: 'filters',
  fields: [
    { value: 'createdDate', label: 'Created Date', type: 'date' }
  ],
  showClearAll: true
}
```

#### Supported Field Types
- **text** - Text input with text operators
- **number** - Number input with numeric operators (values stored as numbers)
- **boolean** - True/false dropdown
- **date** - Native date picker with date operators (ISO format)
- **select** - Dropdown with custom options

#### Supported Operators
- **Text Fields**: Equals, Does not equal, Contains, Does not contain, Is empty, Is not empty
- **Number Fields**: Equals, Does not equal, Greater than, Less than, Greater or equal, Less or equal, Is empty, Is not empty
- **Boolean Fields**: Equals, Does not equal
- **Date Fields**: Equals, Does not equal, Before, After, Between, Is empty, Is not empty
- **Select Fields**: Equals, Does not equal, In, Not in, Is empty, Is not empty

### 🔧 Code Quality Improvements
- ✅ Used `crypto.randomUUID()` directly for ID generation (removed unnecessary prefix)
- ✅ Correct useEffect implementation with JSON.stringify comparison to prevent stale closures
- ✅ Enhanced type safety for value input handling
- ✅ Smart input rendering based on field type
- ✅ Proper type conversion for number fields (string → number)
- ✅ Date formatting for ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD)
- ✅ Support for options in select fields
- ✅ Clear all functionality with visual feedback
- ✅ No security vulnerabilities (CodeQL scan passed)
- ✅ All tests passing

### 📚 Documentation
- Created comprehensive documentation in `packages/components/docs/FilterBuilder.md`
- Added examples for all field types (text, number, boolean, date, select)
- Includes usage examples, API reference, and integration guide
- Documented all operators for each field type

### 🧪 Testing
To view the demo locally:
```bash
pnpm --filter prototype dev
# Visit http://localhost:5173/?demo=filter-builder
```

### 🔍 Security Summary
✅ No vulnerabilities detected by CodeQL scanner
